title: AI Feedback You Should Reject
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting ai feedback you should reject to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Apply the defensibility test to decide whether to keep or reject an AI resume suggestion.
Classify a failed AI suggestion as fabrication, inflation, keyword stuffing, or identity guessing.
Audit a whole-document AI rewrite line by line and log each rejection with its reason in the critique log.
Explain the asymmetric-cost rule: default to leaving out a flattering claim you could not defend.
